name: Dimitri Volkov
bio: Dimitri's journey into motorsport began later in life, after a successful career in advertising for consumer goods. Frustrated with the predictability of that industry, he sought a more dynamic and passionate field. He enrolled in marketing courses specializing in sports and entertainment, eventually landing an internship with a small racing team. Dimitri views marketing as storytelling, focusing on crafting compelling narratives around drivers and teams to connect with fans on a deeper level. While his technical knowledge is still developing, his ability to see the big picture and inspire those around him makes him a valuable asset.

physical.description: Dimitri has a kind face and a somewhat professorial air about him.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn copy of 'The Art of War' for inspiration.
Insists on starting every meeting with a brief, philosophical quote.
Has a habit of sketching marketing ideas on napkins during lunch.
